key_idea: Linearity of expectation: every room is in the window of exactly 2k+1 players (2k+1<=n so no wrap overlap), so each player wins with probability (2k/(2k+1))^(2k).
sketch: Player i picks one of 2k+1 rooms uniformly; for any such room exactly 2k other players have it in their window, each avoiding it with probability 2k/(2k+1). So P(win)= (2k/(2k+1))^(2k) regardless of room and the answer is n*(2k/(2k+1))^(2k) mod 998244353 using a modular inverse and fast power. O(log) time. Only pitfall is noticing the constraint k<=(n-1)/2 makes windows non-self-overlapping.
